summary_en: This study tests the RAS(ON) inhibitors daraxonrasib, elironrasib, and zoldonrasib combined with ivonescimab in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have a RAS mutation, including non-small cell lung cancer and colorectal cancer. The RAS(ON) inhibitors are taken as oral tablets, and ivonescimab is given by IV infusion, with some groups also receiving carboplatin or cisplatin with pemetrexed, or cetuximab, by IV infusion; how often and how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and early antitumor activity, and it is a Phase 1/2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba los inhibidores RAS(ON) daraxonrasib, elironrasib y zoldonrasib combinados con ivonescimab en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen una mutación RAS, incluido cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y cáncer colorrectal. Los inhibidores RAS(ON) se toman como tabletas orales, e ivonescimab se administra por infusión intravenosa; algunos grupos también reciben carboplatino o cisplatino con pemetrexed, o cetuximab, por infusión intravenosa. La frecuencia y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral preliminar, y es un estudio de fase 1/2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who have given informed consent
Advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a RAS mutation in KRAS, HRAS, or NRAS
not_for: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
Conditions that may affect taking or absorbing the study drug
